name: PENTA
recent: 公司于2026年11月5日公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，营收与净利同比大幅增长。近期公告主要为雇员公积金局、公务员退休基金及Prudential PLC等大股东权益变动申报。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日季度业绩，营收2.240亿令吉，净利2,046万令吉。
多家机构股东（EPF、KWAP、Prudential PLC）在10月底至11月中持续申报权益变动。
risks: 有新闻标题指业绩低于市场预期。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收2.240亿令吉，环比增长23.9%，同比增长54.6%；净利2,046万令吉，环比增长7.5%，同比增长76.2%；净利率9.1%，低于上一季度的10.5%。

recent_en: The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 5 November 2026, with revenue and net profit rising sharply year-on-year. Recent announcements were mainly substantial shareholder interest changes by EPF, KWAP and Prudential PLC.
notable_en: Reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 with revenue of MYR224.0 million and net profit of MYR20.5 million.
Several institutional shareholders (EPF, KWAP, Prudential PLC) continued to file changes in their interests from late October to mid-November.
risks_en: Quarterly net margin declined to 9.1% from 10.5%.
A news headline indicated earnings fell short of market expectations.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was MYR224.0 million, up 23.9% QoQ and 54.6% YoY; net profit was MYR20.5 million, up 7.5% QoQ and 76.2% YoY; net margin was 9.1%, down from 10.5% in the previous quarter.
